name: Says what changed in the captures and why

item_template.title: Review the visual check output
item_template.description: The visual check did not pass on this branch. Its command and output are in the thread. Look at every capture it produced and decide whether the change was intended.
item_template.acceptance_criteria: Given the captures, when a layout is broken at any viewport, then the cause is named.

judge_criteria: The summary names a viewport or screen it looked at, not just that it looked.
The summary says whether the change was intended, and why, rather than only that something changed.

notes: This step is an agent rather than a script because it can see images. A summary that never names a viewport is a summary written without opening one.

name: Asks when there is nothing to look at
notes: No check output means no captures and no baseline. Blessing a baseline here would bless an image nobody produced, which is the one thing this agent must never do.

name: Fixes the layout, not the tolerance

item_template.title: Fix the narrow-viewport overflow
item_template.description: The visual check reported overflow at the narrow viewport on this branch. Fix the cause.
item_template.acceptance_criteria: Given the narrow viewport, when the page renders, then nothing overflows horizontally.

notes: Raising a pixel tolerance turns the check green and leaves the overflow on screen. The config files are where that would show, and a diff-only review would never see it.
